data.one_liner: A hierarchical tree view widget with animations, based on AnimatedList.
data.what_it_does: Visualizes hierarchical tree data structures as linear list views using AnimatedList and SliverAnimatedList. Supports infinite nesting levels, node expansion and collapse animations, customizable indentation, and tree diffing.
use_when: You need to display hierarchical or tree-structured data in your Flutter app.
You want smooth expand and collapse animations for nested tree nodes.
You require support for both standard lists and slivers.
avoid_when: You only need a flat, non-nested list view (use standard ListView or AnimatedList instead).
You need extremely complex indexed node operations on large datasets where O(n^m) traversal cost becomes a bottleneck.
strengths: Supports infinite levels and child nodes with built-in expansion animations.
Offers both standard (TreeView) and sliver (SliverTreeView) variants.
Includes Tree Diff Util to automatically apply changes when the underlying tree updates.
weaknesses: Indexed tree variants have an expensive traversal complexity of O(n^m).
Requires specific controller setup (AutoScrollController) for certain expansion behaviors in slivers.
